findings.summary: Default _default_has_harvest_receipt keys on note_type=evidence only and cannot enforce the spec's evidence- idempotency_key prefix: the agent-bus read surface (GET /v1/channels/{id}/messages) does not expose idempotency_key (_message_public_fields omits it). The precise evidence- predicate is correctly delegated to the injectable has_harvest_receipt, which the TestHarvestableView cases exercise.
